主要内容: Geospace Technologies (NASDAQ: GEOS) announced it will release second quarter fiscal year 2018 financial results on May 3, 2018, following market close. A conference call will be held on May 4, 2018, at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time. The company designs and manufactures instruments and equipment for the oil and gas industry, used in seismic data acquisition, processing, reservoir characterization, and monitoring activities.
